assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome and paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to guide further management of rate control and anticoagulation therapy.
The clinical indication note documents the medical necessity.
Precertification was missing at the time of service (auth status: missing).
This appeal requests a review of the medical necessity determination for this diagnostic procedure.
